newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-FERDINAND COULD BE ON HIS WAY TO TOTTENHAM.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FERDINAND COULD BE ON HIS WAY TO TOTTENHAM.

text.p: Newcastle's England international striker Les Ferdinand could be on his way back to London to join premier league club Tottenham.
Tottenham's official telephone service for fans said on Thursday that Newcastle were ready to sell the 30-year-old forward and the London club had been given the go-ahead to talk to the player.

Tottenham are coached by Ferdinand's former Queens Park Rangers boss Gerry Francis. Although Everton have also shown an interest in the striker, it is believed that Ferdinand would prefer a return to the capital.
Last week French winger David Ginola left Newcastle to join Tottenham who are keen to boost their squad with major signings before next month's start to the new season.
